description: The Spanish university research team publishes 8,694 synthetic aerial road-scene images and paired semantic segmentations generated with the CARLA simulator and ROS. Scenes include vehicles, pedestrians and crossing markings viewed from virtual elevated cameras. Zenodo identifies the image archives and offers free access under CC BY 4.0. The images can train observation components for traffic simulations or test dangerous-manoeuvre detection before use with real aerial cameras. Coverage is virtual urban traffic, not a measured city or historical period, so weather, road geometry and actor behaviour reflect selected CARLA scenarios. That domain gap limits transfer to operating roads. The archive and segmentation masks were not downloaded or tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: An urban traffic dataset composed of visible images and their semantic segmentation generated by the CARLA simulator
